changes_made.explanation: Normalized mT5-m2m to mT5 since they refer to the same model, cleaned up output descriptions to be more precise about cross-lingual summarization task
Consolidated all ROUGE variants (ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L, mROUGE) under 'ROUGE' base form as per normalization guidelines. Added MoverScore which was mentioned in the paper.
No LLMs were used as evaluators/judges in this paper. LLMs (ChatGPT, davinci-003) were only used as baseline generation models, not for evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper - only automatic metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore, MoverScore) were used for evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on cross-lingual summarization using a differentiable summarize-and-translate pipeline. All evaluations were conducted using automatic metrics only, with extensive quantitative analysis but no human evaluations. The extraction quality was generally good, with minor normalization needed for metric variants.
